reviews.review:
I love the Mass Effect series, so I picked up Mass Effect: Andromeda when it first released and loved it.

Yes, it had its problems, but none of them stopped me from having a great time. I thought the world, characters, exploration, and gameplay made it well worth my time and money.

A few years later, I played through it again and still enjoyed it. Then I had my boyfriend play it, despite him never having played a Mass Effect game before, and he had a great time with it too.

Andromeda gets a lot of criticism, but I've always loved it. It's a game I've happily returned to, and I'd recommend giving it a chance instead of letting its reputation make the decision for you.
I wish if they could've made this game more intresting and clear, also not buggy!

I heard bad things, but it was worse than I imagined!

This game is B O R I N G. The gameplay is boring, the weapons and powers are boring, the locations and side quests are boring, and absolutely nothing about the story was interesting! I loved the original trilogy, but this is just not fun. My litmus test for a game being good or bad is it it's just fun to sit down and play, not feel like I'm at my job trying to painstakingly trudge through it! 

Regarding the gameplay, I had heard about all the issues and glitches and even waited as long as I did to play it so they could (hopefully) have it fixed and not have NPCs fly off like they're Superman and break their bodies apart as though they're trying to enter orbit. The gameplay is boring too! In the other game you actually felt like you kicked someone's ass if you used biotics or lit them up with a heavy gun like the Carnifex. Andromeda has none of that, no sense of satisfaction or fun. This does not even feel like mass effect, it played more like super mario bros. with all the jumping and other nonsense. In fact, I think they could have made this it's own standalone game of a completely different series (but why do that when you could slap the name of a well-established franchise on it for publicity with loose tie-ins?) 

Also, not for nothing, but did the ghost of Ray Charles handle the art for this game?! The characters don't even look like human beings! The running animation made my character look like she had two giant hotdogs for legs while actively trying to sit and run simultaneously, it's SO bizarre. I even had to replay the opening section because I couldn't focus on what was being said from laughing whenever the camera panned to my character's face. She looked like Moe from the simpsons!


Game should be retitled mAss Effect - emphasis on the ASS, because it is ASS!

Very disappointing. Bioware has not been Bioware for a very long time.
